info.text:
A millionaire can have no credit score at all.
FICO scores (300 to 850) are built to predict the odds of falling 90+ days behind on a debt within 24 months.
The average FICO score was 695 in 2015, a record 718 in 2023 and 714 in April 2026 (FICO, April readings).
Our math: $1M saved, no debt, never borrowed = no FICO score. Owning $60,000 and owing $95,000 = net worth of -$35,000, yet on-time payments can still mean a high score.
The CFPB estimated about 7.0 million US adults had no credit record in Dec 2020.
Sources: FICO, myFICO, CFPB (June 2025 update).
News and education, not financial advice.
